svg.title: Slingshot — planning with the gravity grid and burn nodes
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup (ship and planning view): the restyled gravity grid tinted by well depth with the dashed tidal ring, a selected correction burn node with its dv chip and delete button, and an idle capture node.
